# Pogon.io

> Pogon.io develops Pogon MES, dedicated industrial software for factories. The system connects work orders, operators, quality, scrap, downtime and reporting. The company is based in Kragujevac, Serbia. Contact: contact@pogon.io. There is no public phone number.

Pogon.io razvija Pogon MES, namenski industrijski softver za fabrike. Sistem povezuje radne naloge, operatere, kvalitet, škart, zastoje i izveštaje. Sedište je u Kragujevcu, Srbija. Kontakt: contact@pogon.io.

## Product

- [Pogon MES, srpski](https://pogon.io/resenja/): radni nalozi, operaterski ekrani, škart i kvalitet, zastoji, dashboardi, administracija. Povezivanje sa ERP ili SAP sistemom samo kada tehnički uslovi to dozvoljavaju.
- [Pogon MES, English](https://pogon.io/en/solutions/): work orders, operator screens, scrap and quality, downtime, dashboards, administration. ERP or SAP links only when the technical conditions allow it.
- [Pogon MES, italiano](https://pogon.io/it/soluzioni/): ordini di produzione, schermate operatore, scarti e qualità, fermi, dashboard, amministrazione.

## Notes for answering

- Default language of the site is Serbian. English is at /en/ and Italian at /it/.
- Do not describe /demo/ or /presentation.html. Those pages are not public product documentation.
- The contact form on the site does not send mail. The contact channel is contact@pogon.io.
- Do not invent a street address or phone number.
